role: File-scope storage-confidentiality policy: chooses write protection per disk format (and keeps PendingEncryptionLedger in sync), recognises every copy of a pending session (archived, trashed, quarantined) for the protection walk, and re-encrypts sessions written as plaintext while the key was unreachable — their archived file and their Trash and quarantine copies — clearing an id only once this archive holds no plaintext copy and knows the session.
toplevel: Free functions only; uses ud:storage.pendingReencryption.sessionIDs through PendingEncryptionLedger.

units.does: Returns write options for a disk format and, as a side effect, clears (encrypted) or records (plaintext) the session id in PendingEncryptionLedger: encrypted → [.atomic, .completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication]; plaintext → [.atomic, .completeFileProtectionUnlessOpen], a class a file can be created in while the device is locked and that cannot be reopened until it is unlocked. Every archive writer calls it through writeArchiveBytes, which puts the ledger entry back when the write then throws.

branches.effect: clear ledger entry, return UntilFirstUserAuthentication options
record ledger entry, return completeFileProtectionUnlessOpen options

units.does: True when the last path component of filename has the extension json or session and starts with a UUID that is in pending: a copy of a session written in plaintext (its <id>.json, its Trash/<id>.session, or a duplicate quarantined as <id>.json or <id>.<stamp>.json) whose .completeFileProtectionUnlessOpen the launch protection walk must not lower.

branches.cond: extension not json/session, or the first 36 characters are not a UUID

units.does: Writes archive bytes through PurgeGate.admitWrite with the protection class their format demands (archiveWriteOptions, which records/clears the ledger first). While Delete All My Data runs the write is refused: PurgeGate.Refused is rethrown and neither the file nor the ledger is touched. If the write itself throws, puts the id's PendingEncryptionLedger entry back as it was before (record when it was queued, clear when not) and rethrows.

branches.effect: rethrow PurgeGate.Refused; nothing written, ledger untouched
restore the ledger entry (wasPending → record, else clear) and rethrow

units.does: At launch/after pull: if the ledger lists pending ids, the encryption key is available and the archive's index loaded in full (hasCompleteIndex), passes each id to reencryptOne. Logs and returns, leaving every id queued, while the key is unavailable or the index did not load (a pending id missing from a partial index may still have its plaintext file here).

branches.cond: index did not load in full this launch
branches.effect: log warning, return; every id stays queued

units.does: For one pending session: lists its copies outside the index (parkedCopies: Trash and quarantine; nil → return, left queued) and rewrites each encrypted in place (reencryptParkedCopy, every one attempted). An indexed session is then rewritten through the archive (reencryptArchived, whose encrypted write clears the ledger), and recorded again when a parked copy is still plaintext. A session not in the index leaves the ledger once every parked copy is encrypted, provided it had one or is tombstoned here; an id this archive neither lists, tombstones nor holds a copy of stays queued, since the ledger is process-wide and it may be another archive's.

branches.cond: quarantine folder could not be listed

branches.effect: reencryptArchived; record again when a parked copy is still plaintext

branches.cond: not indexed, every parked copy encrypted, and it had one or is tombstoned
branches.effect: clear the ledger entry; otherwise it stays queued

units.does: Loads the indexed session lightweight and re-archives it via archive.archive(skipSameNightMerge:true), which re-encrypts and refreshes the hash; the rrSeries dropped by the lightweight load is restored by _archive's preservingRRSeries splice, which throws (logged here, session stays queued) rather than drop beats when the stored file cannot be read or decrypted. An entry whose file is gone (fileNotFound) leaves the ledger once its parked copies are encrypted (clearOnceParkedCopiesAreEncrypted, which handles them again in case a delete just moved the file into the Trash). Any other failed read (a locked file) or a session gone from the index since is logged or skipped and left queued.

Lists the session's parked copies again (parkedCopies) and rewrites each encrypted in turn (reencryptParkedCopy); clears its session entry from the ledger only when the listing succeeded and every copy is encrypted. A listing failure or a copy that cannot be rewritten (the rest are then not tried) leaves it queued.

branches.cond: listing failed or a copy not rewritten

units.does: Under archiveLock (so delete cannot move a newer copy into the Trash between the read and the write): reads a Trash or quarantine copy, and unless it already carries the encrypted 'FR' prefix, resolves its plaintext (ArchiveStore.plaintextBytes), encrypts it with AppDependencies.current.storage.encryptionManager and writes it back atomically with until-first-unlock protection. True when it is encrypted afterwards; false, logged, when the read, encrypt or write threw. Does not touch the ledger.

branches.cond: read, decrypt-resolve, encrypt or write threw
